newsitem.title: EGYPT: Anchor investor sought for Egypt container firm.
newsitem.headline: Anchor investor sought for Egypt container firm.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Holding Company for Maritime Transport said on Saturday it was about to offer 10 percent of Alexandria Container Handling for sale to a local or foreign anchor investor.
Alexandria Container Handling is the largest company of its kind in Egypt, it said. It will be the first of the holding company's subsidiaries to undergo partial privatisation.
The holding company said National Bank of Egypt would act as agent for the sale and it would give full details soon.
